newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah down in late trade on liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah down in late trade on liquidity.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was down against the dollar in slow late trading on Tuesday on the back of relatively ample rupiah liquidity, dealers said.
One local bank dealer said overnight money fell to five percent in the afternoon from 10/11 percent due to the ample liquidity.
"Liquidity seemed to be the main cause for the weakening of the rupiah, with players paying less attention to the Thai economic problems," the dealer said.
Spot rupiah was last quoted at 2432.00/32.50 at 1005 GMT against an opening of 2429.50/30.50.
Another bank dealer said the spot rupiah trading range was seen between 2432.0 and 2433.0 on Wednesday on the back of continuing sufficient liquidity.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,431.75/32.00 and 2,431.50/32.00, respectively.
Overnight swaps were at 0.10/0.20 and tom/next at 0.20/0.25 points.
Dealers said the month-end and half-year book closing factors would only have strong impacts on rupiah liquidity from next week.
One-month swaps were at 14.50/15.50, two at 29.00/29.50, three at 43.00/45.00 and six at 86.50/88.00 points.
The central bank kept its intervention band at 2,424/2,616 and its conversion band also at 2,424/2,472 on Tuesday.
